I NTRODUCTION Collaborative perception has emerged as a promising paradigm for autonomous driving, where connected vehicles and infrastructure agents share complementary perceptual information to extend the sensing range and mitigate occlusion [1]-[5].
In this work, we focus on collaborative 3D object detection, where an ego agent fuses observations from multiple connected agents to localize objects in dynamic traffic scenes.

deploymentClaims: A single model is trained per dataset with the latency τ uniformly sampled from 0 to 400 ms as augmentation, and evaluated at fixed τ ∈ {0, 100, 200, 300, 400} ms applied to the non-ego agent.

EgoRefine consistently achieves the best AP@0.5 and AP@0.7 on both datasets across all evaluated latency settings, demonstrating its effectiveness under both synchronous and asynchronous collaboration.
